title: Listening Drill — Making a paper model — Guided practice
description: Practical demonstration. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Making a paper model — Guided practice
sections.transcript:
TUTOR: Before our demonstration on making a paper model, let me explain what you need and what to record. Collect your materials from the model room before the demonstration begins. Inside the handout you will find a blank finished sample to fill in.

TUTOR: Watch the demonstration once before you try it. Before you begin, check for the fault that affected the previous group: blunt blade. If you notice it, let me know instead of making an adjustment yourself.

TUTOR: Now work in pairs. After the first attempt, check fold position and write the result down immediately. You then have twenty-five minutes to compare your result with your partner’s. You can disagree, but both partners should keep a note of what they observed.

TUTOR: On your way out, take anything you borrowed back to the school office. Please leave your notes in the folder so we can discuss them next time.
